evidence.notes: The lookup filter exposes its controlling fields property.
The lookup filter exposes its dependent property.
The lookup filter exposes its optionalFilter property.
The lookup filter returns its controlling fields.
The lookup filter reports that it is dependent.
The lookup filter reports that it is optional.
The populated lookup filter supports object equality.
The populated lookup filter supports hashing.
The populated lookup filter has a descriptive string form.

source.content: Schema.DescribeFieldResult lookupField = Contact.AccountId.getDescribe(); Schema.FilteredLookupInfo info = lookupField.getFilteredLookupInfo(); System.assertNotEquals(null, info); System.assertEquals(1, info.getControllingFields().size()); System.assertEquals('Account.Name', info.getControllingFields()[0]); System.assertEquals(info.getControllingFields(), info.controllingFields); System.assert(info.isDependent()); System.assertEquals(info.isDependent(), info.dependent); System.assert(info.isOptionalFilter()); System.assertEquals(info.isOptionalFilter(), info.optionalFilter); System.assert(info.equals(info)); System.assert(!info.equals(null)); System.assertNotEquals(0, info.hashCode()); System.assert(info.toString().contains('FilteredLookupInfo'));
